```yaml
name: CodeX Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    paths:
      - 'tooling/typescript-config/**'
      - 'docs/guides/typescript-6-readiness.md'
      - 'docs/ai/rules/typescript-future-proofing.md'
      - 'scripts/tsconfig-future-audit.mjs'

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  notify-code-owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Determine Code Owner
        id: codeowner
        run: |
          # Simple heuristic: if changes touch tooling/typescript-config, assign to @typescript-team
          # In a real scenario, this would use a more robust CODEOWNERS parser or API call
          if [[ -n "$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} | grep 'tooling/typescript-config')" ]]; then
            echo "owner=@typescript-team" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "owner=@docs-team" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const owner = '${{ steps.codeowner.outputs.owner }}';
            const message = `
            ### CodeX Review Notification
            This PR contains changes related to TypeScript 6/7 readiness preparation.
            
            **Assigned Reviewer:** ${owner}
            
            Please review the following key areas:
            1. Explicit defaults in \`tooling/typescript-config/base.json\`
            2. Removal of redundant \`baseUrl\` in tsconfigs
            3. Documentation updates in \`docs/guides/typescript-6-readiness.md\`
            4. Audit script functionality in \`scripts/tsconfig-future-audit.mjs\`
            
            > Note: This is a conservative preparation pass; no compiler version bump is included.
            `;
            
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: message
            });
```
